criteria.text: The agent badge pill must show the correct label for the initial agentId ('Claude Code' when agentId='claude-code').
criteria.test_id: issue #645 — agent pill re-renders when session agent changes c1: badge shows Claude Code label for agentId=claude-code

criteria.text: When session.providerId changes to a different agent (e.g. 'codex') while session.agentId stays the same (e.g. 'claude-code'), the badge must update to show the new agent's label/icon ('Codex'). This covers the setSessionModel flow where PATCH /agent-sessions/:id updates providerId/modelId but never agent_id.
criteria.test_id: issue #645 — agent pill re-renders when session agent changes c2 (STRICT): badge updates to Codex label when providerId switches to codex
criteria.notes: Root cause: two compounding bugs. (1) context.read in _AgentKindBadge.build() — widget did not subscribe to AgentConfigsController changes. Fixed by changing to context.watch. (2) _AgentKindBadge only looked up byId(session.agentId) which never changes after session creation. Fixed by adding optional providerId param with resolver precedence: when providerId != agentId and byId(providerId) resolves a known config, that config is shown (reflecting the currently active agent). Call sites updated to pass session.providerId.

criteria.text: After AgentConfigsController.notifyListeners() fires, the badge must rebuild and still show the correct label — confirming the context.watch subscription is active.
criteria.test_id: issue #645 — agent pill re-renders when session agent changes c3 (STRICT): badge rebuilds when AgentConfigsController notifies

not_tested: Live model picker interaction (requires full AgentsView widget tree + AgentsController with real WS + repository stubs — covered by manual smoke).
The case where session.agentId IS updated (e.g. via SessionUpdatedMessage with a different agentId) — this path already worked correctly before the fix.

providerId values that do NOT map to a known agent config ID (e.g. 'anthropic') — in this case the badge falls through to byId(agentId) and shows the original session agent, which is the expected fallback behavior.
